Initial release of dlazy-keling-sfx.

- Generate scene sound effects from text descriptions or video frames using Kling SFX.
- Command-line usage via dlazy keling-sfx with detailed options for prompts, videos, duration, and sound effect modes.
- Includes comprehensive error handling and user guidance for common issues (e.g., insufficient credits, missing API key).
- Output format provides generated audio/video URLs.
- Installation instructions and usage tips included.
